beta.title: This module is in beta
beta.body: Today the database console is read-only — it lets you explore schemas, browse table data and run queries. In an upcoming release you'll be able to **edit tables directly**, change their structure, **add or rename columns and adjust their types**, **create and manage indexes**, define relations and constraints — all **without writing a single migration**. Antelope is actively building this; it ships alongside the **Module Builder**, the upcoming way to configure the whole platform without writing code.
